context_purpose: The rental desk must confirm a foreign visitor may lawfully be contracted with and is identifiable for the rental, while the hostel has its own lodging-registration duty.

norm_violation_today.reason: A second business duplicating the passport image is plausible rental KYC, but the copy also travels into LINE chats and a second file, which exceeds what the rental needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: An anonymous entry-status token cannot give the rental firm or its insurer the name, driving licence and contact needed for the contract, liability and recovery of a vehicle.

transmission_check.reason: Rental firms and insurers likely require the driver's identity and licence regardless of the hostel check, and I cannot confirm any rule on passport copies.

context_purpose: The organiser wants only eligible chapter members to vote once on a local project, so the result is credible.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID photos and membership card photos kept in a shared drive go far beyond an eligibility and one-vote check, and party membership is sensitive political affiliation.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little is lost; the organiser needs only a member-in-district claim and a once-per-forum nullifier, though vote-selling and coercion remain unsolved.

transmission_check.reason: A private forum has no apparent legal duty to hold ID photos, so a chapter-signed credential is not blocked.

context_purpose: HR must verify that a leave request is legitimate for the dates asked before granting it.

norm_violation_today.reason: Filing the full order, with respondent and abuse details, in a personnel file readable by managers and payroll goes beyond verifying leave dates.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; a time-bounded eligibility attestation covers the leave window, though HR still sees the leave was taken.

transmission_check.reason: The employee hands over the order to obtain leave, and I cannot say whether labour rules require the employer to keep the document.

context_purpose: The school must release a child only to an adult the guardian has authorised, for child safety.

norm_violation_today.reason: Copying the ID and leaving phone numbers in a gate logbook readable by any later guard keeps more than a one-off authorisation check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A yes/no token cannot bind the presenter to the person authorised without a photo or code, and the school may want an accountable record of who collected the child.

transmission_check.reason: Schools may be expected to keep pickup records for child safety, and I cannot confirm any rule requiring ID copies.

context_purpose: Court security wants to admit only people with business at the court that day and screen for safety.

norm_violation_today.reason: Case type and names are exposed to bystanders in a public queue, a wider audience than the guard's access-control purpose requires.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A bare attendance pass loses the guard's ability to direct people to the right division and to check ID for high-risk hearings.

transmission_check.reason: Court entry rules may require ID or the notice, and I cannot confirm what is mandated.

context_purpose: Court security must admit only expected participants and screen visitors for safety.

norm_violation_today.reason: Showing the summons with parties and cause of action goes beyond an entry check, but courts routinely and legitimately inspect ID at the door.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: An anonymous token drops the identity check and the visitor log that security may need for high-risk hearings or later incident tracing.

transmission_check.reason: Security and visitor-register rules may require identification, and I cannot confirm the rules.

context_purpose: The landlord needs evidence that the tenant qualifies for early lease termination so it can release her without penalty.

norm_violation_today.reason: The full order exposes the respondent, case facts and ID number to a private third party who needs only a validity window.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the landlord needs a valid-through-date claim, though it may still want to confirm the statutory right applies and that the order is not revoked.

transmission_check.reason: The tenant volunteers the order to exercise a termination right, and I cannot confirm whether the law prescribes the form of proof.

context_purpose: HR must confirm that a leave or schedule request is legitimate for the requested dates.

norm_violation_today.reason: Copying the whole order into a personnel file that supervisors and payroll can read exceeds what leave verification requires.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; an active-order-for-these-dates attestation covers the decision, though employer habit and legal caution may resist.

transmission_check.reason: The employee volunteers the order for leave and the leave entitlement itself is unclear, so I cannot say whether any document is required.
